# Awesome SEO & GEO Skills

[中文](README.md) · **English**

> A curated list of agent skills for SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization): keyword research, content optimization, technical audits and rank tracking, plus getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Chinese AI assistants such as Doubao, Yuanbao and Kimi. Install them into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Qwen, Doubao or WorkBuddy.

This list collects SEO and GEO skills for AI agents. SEO gets you ranked by search engines; GEO gets you mentioned and cited in AI answers. Most use the standard SKILL.md format, so any agent that supports skills can install them; see the [FAQ](#faq). Every project was checked by hand and scanned by a script before it was listed, and is sorted by job and by the search engine or AI platform it targets. Chinese AI search (Doubao, Yuanbao, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen) has its own section.

178 skill projects + 53 MCP servers and CLI tools · metadata updated 2026-11-23

**Legend**: 🌟 featured · 📝 prompt files (not a standard skill) · 🔌 MCP server or CLI tool · 🧩 full app · 💤 not updated for 180+ days · 📦 archived · ⚠️ repo unavailable

**Let your agent choose**: this list is also a skill. Run `npx skills add UnderleveledBuilder/awesome-seo-geo-skills` to install seo-geo-skill-finder, then ask your agent "I want ChatGPT and Perplexity to cite my docs site. Which skill should I install?"

> [!NOTE]
> "Checked by hand" means the README, directory structure and classification were reviewed; it does not mean the output was tested. The script scan looks for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files, and lists the network addresses in scripts. A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe.

## New this week

5 added in the last 7 days:

- [aso-skills](https://github.com/ASOScan/aso-skills) ★9: 9 skills for App Store Optimization on the App Store and Google Play: keyword volume and difficulty, daily ranks, keyword opportunities, competitor keywords, review insights and a listing audit, read from your own apps through the ASOScan API.
- [Mydentify AI Crawler Access Checker](https://github.com/mitdralla/mydentify-ai-crawler-access-checker) ★0: Dependency-free Node.js CLI that checks a public page against the robots.txt rules, indexing directives and user-agent responses for six documented OpenAI and Anthropic crawlers. Needs Node 20+, no API key.
- [citeready-cli](https://github.com/zColdWater/citeready-cli) ★0: Zero-dependency CLI and GitHub Action for AI Search (GEO) technical readiness: audits 10 global and China AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Doubao, Baidu), Schema.org Entity Graph depth, and /llms.txt, read-only with no account.
- [new-term-radar](https://github.com/zhuyansen/new-term-radar) ★2.2k: Daily radar for new AI names (models, products, repos) caught on X, Hugging Face trending, GitHub breakouts and directory sitemaps before keyword tools list them, then a keyword priority table. Three skills, an MCP server and a CLI; X needs a paid AIsa key.
- [backlink-guard](https://github.com/zhuyansen/backlink-guard) ★78: Checks a link source before you submit to it, verifies the link once live, and audits your own backlinks for what Google calls link spam; also finds competitors' referring domains. A skill, an MCP server and a CLI; spam scores need a paid key.

<a id="group-cn-ai"></a>
### Chinese AI search: Doubao, Yuanbao, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen

Optimization for Chinese AI assistants and Baidu. Their crawling differs from English AI search: GitHub blocks ByteDance's crawler, for example, so Doubao can hardly read GitHub pages directly and off-site content matters.

- 🌟 **[yao-geo-skills](https://github.com/yaojingang/yao-geo-skills)** · ★ 925<br>Yao GEO Skills: 24 GEO skills for strategy diagnosis, page technicals, content production, knowledge assets, monitoring and attribution, and research, including crawlers for Doubao, DeepSeek and ChatGPT answers.<br><sub>Targets: ChatGPT · Baidu · Doubao · 元宝 · Kimi · DeepSeek · Qwen</sub><br><sub>updated 2026-10-01 · Multilingual · 24 skills · MIT</sub>

<a id="faq"></a>
## FAQ

### What is GEO, and how is it different from SEO?

SEO (search engine optimization) gets your pages ranked by search engines such as Google and Bing. GEO (generative engine optimization, also called AEO) gets you mentioned and cited in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and others. They overlap: AI search usually starts from search engine results, so good SEO is the base of GEO. But AI answers care more about passages they can quote directly, clear sources, and how often other sites mention you. GEO-focused projects are under [GEO: get cited in AI answers](#group-geo) (42).

### What are the best agent skills for SEO?

This list has 178 hand-checked SEO and GEO skill projects (data updated 2026-11-23). For one system that covers most of the work, start with [All-in-one](#group-pipeline) (35); the most-starred are [marketingskills](https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills), [claude-seo](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo) and [notfair-plugin](https://github.com/nowork-studio/notfair-plugin). For a single step, go to the keywords and ranking data, content, technical audit or backlinks sections.

### Do these skills need paid SEO data?

It depends. Skills that rely only on the model and page fetching don't. Those that look up search volume, backlinks or rankings usually need Search Console (free) or a paid API such as Ahrefs, Semrush or DataForSEO; each entry says what it needs.

### What about Chinese AI assistants and Baidu?

Projects built for them are under [Chinese AI search](#group-cn-ai) (5); some in other sections also cover Doubao or Kimi, and 8 in total explicitly target Doubao. Chinese assistants crawl differently from English AI search: GitHub's robots.txt blocks ByteDance's crawler (Bytespider), for example, so Doubao can hardly read GitHub pages directly and relies on off-site content such as WeChat articles, Zhihu and Toutiao. See [By search engine and AI platform](#by-engines).

### Are these projects safe to install?

Every repo was checked by hand (README, folders and files) and scanned by a script for binaries and archives, install hooks, remote code execution and reads of sensitive files. 178 skill projects and 53 tools made the list. Repos that were reviewed and turned down are recorded with the reason in [data/ignore.toml](data/ignore.toml) (in Chinese; 497 so far). A clean scan does not prove a skill is safe, so read its `SKILL.md` and scripts before installing.

### How often is the list updated?

Every Monday, stars, last-updated dates and licenses refresh automatically and new repos are searched; new repos are added only after a manual check. See [New this week](#new).
